sections.label: SegretarIA
sections.name: Segretar
sections.lead: Your new right hand for messages, reminders, accounting and clients: she works quietly in the background and checks with you when it matters.

disclaimer.title: Human-in-the-loop
disclaimer.text: It means you always have the last word. The AI drafts, suggests and organises; a person reviews and decides. Every message SegretarIA prepares goes through you: approve it as it is, or tweak it before it's sent.

features.title: Incoming and outgoing messages
features.text: SegretarIA reads your customers' messages and drafts a reply. Approve it with a tap, or edit it yourself before it goes out.

features.title: Automatic customer reminders
features.text: Set them up the way you need: a reminder the day before an appointment asking to confirm, or a recurring nudge for a renewal or a follow-up. Great for keeping customers coming back.

features.title: Your finances on one dashboard
features.text: Income, expenses and due dates in one place, with reminders for customers who haven't paid.

features.title: A CRM made for you
features.text: Keeps track of every customer: who they are, what they asked for, and when you last spoke.

features.title: Weekly stats and reports
features.text: A weekly report shows you how things are going, and SegretarIA adds a short note with her own take on the numbers.

sections.example: Already have someone answering customers? Great: from today their title can be ‘Customer Success Specialist’, while SegretarIA handles the repetitive paperwork.

closing.title: Did you know?
closing.text: Meta's bots (WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram) don't support a built-in human-in-the-loop process like the one described above. We found a way around it, and that's how SegretarIA was born: your new, irreplaceable right hand.
